title: Refund Policy
disclaimer: This is not legal advice. This policy describes refund conditions for digital MVP deliveries.

sections.title: General Policy
sections.text: All products are digital deliverables generated specifically for each customer. Refunds are not available once delivery has been completed.

sections.title: Non-Delivery Refund
sections.text: If your product has not been delivered within 24 hours of payment confirmation, you are entitled to a full refund. Contact support@mvpfactory.de with your order details.

sections.title: Refund Processing
sections.text: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5–10 business days, depending on your bank or payment provider.
